ruleDefinitions.name: User Added To Highly Privileged Group
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects addition of users to highly privileged groups via "Net" or "Add-LocalGroupMember".

sequences.query: (((process_command_line = RGX(".*localgroup\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/add.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*Add\\-LocalGroupMember\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-Group\\ .*"))) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*Group\\ Policy\\ Creator\\ Owners.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Schema\\ Admins.*")))
